description.text: This is Full-time MBA program, you should complete your study in two years (consisting of four consecutive semesters); SISU MBA Program is split into two different yet complementary learning experiences. The required courses cover traditional management disciplines, leadership, ethics, and interpersonal skills needed in business world, as well as integration and global experience module. The elective courses develop your career goals from the different areas. Required Course The Pre-Term program ensures that the new class begins the fall term with a consistent level of introductory knowledge. You are required to participate in all the activities in the Pre-Term as it is part of the required courses of SISU MBA. The Pre-Term program offers: preparatory courses in accounting, finance and statistics in fundamental level to make sure you understand the basic knowledge prior to fall term coursework. language courses, seminars in career development, as well as lectures in soft skills workshops. Varied sharing sessions from faculty and employers are a prominent part of Pre-Term to prepare you for MBA study planning and know about the perspectives from outside community. induction session to university’s facilities and resources, rules and regulations to guide your MBA journey. case day to familiarize you with this typical MBA learning method. one-day off-campus team-building to build up team spirit. You will be assigned to a learning team for the first semester of the program. Electives and Concentrations International Integrated Marketing and Public Relations Global Fashion and Luxury Management Transnational Management General Management Language Study Living Expenses Accommodation on campus for international studentsCNY50 - 130 per day FoodCNY 40 per day Laundry & air conditioning in residenceCNY 50 per month Scholarship SISU MBA offers scholarship to first-year students. It is awarded based on applications’ academic achievements on entrance national examination results and interview performance. Admitted students will be automatically considered for this scholarship.

duration.text: The MBA in English at Shanghai International Studies University is a 2 Years long program for international students, taught in English.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 9722 USD/per year ￥ 70000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1. Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number &expiration date and name included. 2. Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. 3. Bachelor's degree diploma Graduation certificate should be in Chinese or English.If not, it should be translated into Chinese or English and be notarized. 4. Transcript of undergraduate school 5. Two recommendation letters From professor,associate professor or equivalents. 6.Other supporting documents 7.Business card 8.Photocopy of company license Only for entrepreneurs

requirements.text: 1.Academic Requirements:Applicant should hold Bachelor's degree diploma or equivalent from recognized university 2.A full-time work experience of three years or longer (Three years or more working experience is expected of bachelors from recognized universities; or Five years or more working experience is expected of three-year college graduates from recognized universities; or Two years or more working experience is expected of master or doctoral degree holders from recognized universities.) 3.Proficiency in English
